scope: Functional requirements and API design reference at baseline 5266daf; current acceptance is tracked in Env/RF checkpoint reports.

proposed_common_contract.entrypoint: PredictRequest {source_handle, operation: tagged union, stop_policy, trace_options}
proposed_common_contract.ownership: Return owned successor/continuation; preserve source root on prediction failure.
proposed_common_contract.rng_policy: Never accept client-supplied RNG or compute prediction by a consumer mirror; call native v0.111.0 operation on private owned branch.

features.vanilla_callsite: Commands/RelicCmd.cs:35-54 calls AddRelicInternal, removes unstackable relics from bags, sets floor and awaits RelicModel.AfterObtained
features.rng_and_context: Clone the exact run/player/room/reward state, selected relic instance and multi-pick order, bags and hooks; let each original AfterObtained choose its own RNG stream.
features.result: Obtained relic and nested cards/potions/relics/curses/transforms/resources/rewards plus pending choices.
features.stop: After obtain effect chain settles, or NeedsChoice / safe room boundary; no future player decisions.
features.gap: No typed hypothetical obtain; source-aware native operation and nested choices required.

features.rng_and_context: The source selects stream/pool; examples: Astrolabe/PandorasBox Niche, Leafy Poultice PlayerRng.Transformations, combat Entropy CombatCardSelection. Preserve selected card refs and batch order.
features.result: Replacement card instances, origins/pile indices, deck delta, and selector facts.
features.stop: At hover for one candidate, NeedsChoice while selection is open, or actual batch completion.
features.gap: Cannot infer a full multi-card transformation from an unselected source.

features.vanilla_callsite: Events/EventOption.cs:174-185 calls BeforeChosen then original OnChosen
features.rng_and_context: Exact EventModel instance/RNG/page, owner/player, option identity, local variables and pending reward/choice prefix.
features.result: Immediate random rewards/upgrades/downgrades, page/follow-up options, combat or minigame transition.
features.stop: First nested choice, minigame/room transition, or settled option effect.
features.gap: RF registry is partial; generic event continuation and choices are missing.

features.rng_and_context: Exact CardReward, original/reroll options and flags, owner Rewards RNG, current cards and concurrent pending rewards; execute original hooks.
features.result: Exact replacement reward rows/ids and hook changes.
features.stop: At same still-open reward after reroll; picking is a later operation.
features.gap: No generic prediction execution for a non-action hover.

features.rng_and_context: Exact inventory/slot/cost/sale state, player gold/potion capacity, inventory duplicates, hook state and shop/potion/relic bags. Execute subclass purchase and source refill policy.
features.result: Purchase success/failure, gold delta, acquired item effects, and exact same-slot restock or empty state.
features.stop: After purchase and restock hooks, or pending choice.
features.gap: A direct restock roll would skip source purchase semantics and is not sufficient.

features.rf_entrypoint: README.en.md feature list; RandomForeseerCode/OutOfCombat/RelicPickupPrediction.cs and event/reward projections
features.rng_and_context: Exact reward, Wing counter/threshold, owner, relic bag order and prior reward context.
features.result: Counter delta; threshold relic and its obtain effects; reward completion behavior.
features.stop: After obtain chain / pending choice; original alternative completes the reward.
features.gap: Must represent callback and post-alternative policy, not merely predict relic bag.

features.rng_and_context: Exact option, player, HP, chosen upgrade cards, mimic context and relic/hooks. Rewards use their normal native RNG.
features.result: Heal/upgrade/resource delta and actual offered rewards, potentially a nested choice.
features.stop: At generated reward/choice, return continuable successor; do not claim it.
features.gap: No general source-aware rest-site hypothetical operation.

features.rng_and_context: Event RNG, dynamic vars/cost, deck/pools, 11x11 board, cells/items, tool, remaining divinations and click order.
features.result: Changed visible cells, completed hidden items and actual rewards.
features.stop: After each click as a continuation; after final click settle reward synchronizer and stop on nested choices.
features.gap: RF patch only lowers fog opacity; no exact native board export/prediction currently.

features.vanilla_callsite: Existing run query privileged include_future query family; read current queued/preselected act facts.
features.rng_and_context: Current run state and preselected next Act. Must not draw/regenerate RNG.
features.result: Next Act, Ancient and Boss identifiers.
features.stop: Immediate query completion; mark privileged, outside agent observation.
features.gap: Uses privileged data boundary; not an ordinary legal action.

features.rng_and_context: Source card/power, combat hand, selector prefs/answers, CombatCardSelection stream and operation order.
features.result: Transformed card instances and pile/deck facts.
features.stop: NeedsChoice if unresolved; otherwise source action completion or safe next decision.
features.gap: Must preserve actual source selection and batch transformations.

features.vanilla_callsite: Combat/CombatManager.cs:1518-1592 (phase one, hooks, BeforeFlush); :1602-1625+ (orb turn-end, Ethereal, hand effects)
features.rng_and_context: All ending players/extra-turn state, hand, orbs, powers, enemies, hooks and native RNG streams.
features.result: Ordered damage/heal/resource/target outcomes plus actual combat phase.
features.stop: Phase one complete, enemy turn started, next player decision, or safe combat end as separately requested.
features.gap: RF's mirror is a subset and does not replace original phase execution.

features.rf_entrypoint: README.en.md Frozen Eye feature and in-combat query helpers
features.operation: Privileged QueryCombatPiles; optionally execute native shuffle branch
features.rng_and_context: Current pile order is state; reshuffle uses RunState.Rng.Shuffle and Hook.ModifyShuffleOrder, with player/source context.
features.result: Current draw order or exact post-shuffle order, visibility-tagged.
features.stop: Query end, or settled native Shuffle without drawing a card.
features.gap: Existing query fields provide some state but not a generalized result/cause trace.

features.rng_and_context: Exact caller/source, pool, dynamic count, player unlocks and CombatCardGeneration stream.
features.result: Generated mutable card refs, order, pile and resulting choices.
features.stop: Source operation settled or NeedsChoice.
features.gap: Do not rebuild factory pools in the consumer.

features.rf_entrypoint: README.en.md Card draw prediction; in-combat card prediction handlers
features.operation: UseCard/UsePotion or other exact source action
features.rng_and_context: Source/target/count/fromHandDraw, hand and piles, Shuffle RNG/hooks and AfterCardDrawn hooks.
features.result: Drawn refs in order and nested effects/choices.
features.stop: Operation settled or next choice/decision.
features.gap: A raw top-of-draw-pile query alone omits hooks and shuffles.

features.vanilla_callsite: Commands/CardSelectCmd.cs:578-632 is a representative selector; exact source card/potion implements the operation.
features.rng_and_context: Source, eligible refs/filter/order, min/max/manual confirmation, owner, actual RNG only if original selection is random.
features.result: Native-random selected refs, or pending options for user choice.
features.stop: NeedsChoice before continuation effects, or operation settled when source auto-selects.
features.gap: Never substitute first valid/heuristic card for unresolved user choice.

features.rng_and_context: Source, player, queue/slots, target set and CombatTargets stream, hook context.
features.result: Channel/evict/evoke order, targets, damage/healing and queue delta.
features.stop: Source operation/turn hook settles, or NeedsChoice.
features.gap: export_orbs is current state, not a future orb-effect operation.

features.rng_and_context: Potion instance, target player, pool/count/procurement rules and caller's CombatCardGeneration.
features.result: Generated option refs/cards and possible selected result.
features.stop: NeedsChoice when potion opens picker; otherwise potion operation end.
features.gap: No auto-answer without source selection semantics.

features.vanilla_callsite: Potion's original Use method into CardPileCmd.Draw/Shuffle at :1007-1133
features.rng_and_context: Potion/source, target player, count, hand/piles/hooks and shuffle stream.
features.result: Drawn instances/order and nested side effects.
features.stop: Potion operation settled or choice.
features.gap: Same native draw contract as cards; no separate mirror.

features.rf_entrypoint: README.en.md Entropic Brew and Alchemize prediction
features.rng_and_context: Exact source and target player, slots, filters/procurement, CombatPotionGeneration.
features.result: Generated potion(s), procurement/blocked result, slot delta and choices.
features.stop: After original generation/procurement chain or choice.
features.gap: Must keep the original stream and capacity rules.

features.rng_and_context: Origin source, count, top/bottom/random position, forceExhaust, piles, shuffle and CombatCardSelection if random, AutoPlayType/target rules.
features.result: Played card refs/order/targets, exhaustion and nested outcomes.
features.stop: After original operation settles or choice.
features.gap: Autoplay is part of source effects, not a standalone heuristic.

features.rng_and_context: Source attack, allow-duplicates policy, hittable target set/order/filters and CombatTargets.
features.result: Per-hit exact target/damage/death/hooks.
features.stop: Source action completion, choice, or safe combat end.
features.gap: Random target must be selected by original branch's native stream.

cross_cutting_risks: RF is demand evidence, not game-rule authority; its combat/out-of-combat mirrors and partial model registries can diverge from vanilla.
Any unresolved player choice returns NeedsChoice and a continuable branch; do not substitute first-candidate selection.
Next-act and Crystal Sphere hidden board are privileged information and must not leak into ordinary RL observations.
Source RNG selection varies by original caller; a generic operation must preserve caller context rather than impose one stream.

baseline_api.implemented: Legal-action one-step owned preview, combat/run queries, v2 before/after projection, logical snapshot for supported simulator state.
baseline_api.gap: No generic source-aware hypothetical operation for hover, no general native stop policy, and incomplete causal/result tracing and arbitrary real-game capture.
